quotes.title: 7 Andromedae
quotes.card: 7 Andromedae, also named Honores, is a single, yellow-white hued star in the northern constellation of Andromeda.
quotes.introduction: 7 Andromedae is the Flamsteed designation, abbreviated 7 And.
